reviewer_statement: Provisional developer source-scientific review only. Native participant-level fixed-basis GEE is recomputed for every draw with 19 canonical source bootstrap provenance keys. Direct Python 1.2 comparison tests are committed but exact-head CI success and independent review are not established.
native_language_semantic_policy: Native R participant-clustered GEE score/sandwich is explicitly retained as a genuine R estimator; returned scientific arrays and source-provenance keys are compared with frozen Python statsmodels GEE. A native R object is not a Python dataclass and its executed score/sandwich backend is native_R_source_score_GEE, not a Python statsmodels fit.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 generalized_function_on_scalar.py typed case bootstrap: n_bootstrap >= 100, integer/NULL NumPy seed, raise-only failure policy, participant-level sampling, one complete fixed-basis GEE score/sandwich refit per draw, no redraw or automatic model selection.

Native strict source GEE scientific fit with 36 curves, 12 participant clusters and 7 observed times; Bernoulli 0/1, grouped binomial integer counts and denominators, Poisson counts and fixed exposure. Legacy R mode preserved, custom sampled indices remain an R-only extension.

Opt-in 100-refit frozen Python direct public export reproduces NumPy PCG64 participant indices and B-by-coefficient-by-time refitted coefficient functions for four declared generalized families/exposure cases. Strict mode uses same fixed basis and real R GEE cluster score/sandwich, not retained coefficient projections.

Strict source record rejects non-boolean flag, legacy reference without canonical native model/score audit, fewer than 100 refits, negative seed and policy other than raise; each failed participant refit produces an explicit non-redraw failure. Python RuntimeError and R condition class differ.

Eight canonical scientific result fields and exactly 19 ordered nested source-bootstrap provenance keys without R-only draw engine, supplied-draw flag or certification claim; audit arrays have source sample order, source original participant IDs, and unique bootstrap group IDs.

Whole-participant case bootstrap of the population-averaged GEE log-link/logit spline coefficient functions with original participant trial bundles, observed exposure/denominators preserved and basis fixed. Distinct copied participants are relabelled as independent clusters. No variance component or arbitrary response-family estimation.

independent_review_status: No confirmed three-OS native R or exact frozen Python source CI pass at commit; independent scientific certification not conducted.
language_specific_limits: Python GeneralizedFunctionOnScalarBootstrapResult dataclass, statsmodels fitted-model Python object and Python exception classes are not native R runtime identity.
Unseeded NumPy random_state=None streams cannot be made identically random to unseeded R streams; seeded NumPy PCG64 streams and explicit index matrices are the tested contracts.
Broader ill-conditioned convergence, non-integer Python seed objects and uncommon NumPy input coercions require further independent testing.
Source reviews and hash attestations are developer-prepared; no independent certificate and no CRAN release claim.
